lines.t: Twins (Sweet Daughter of Mine)”
Verse 1
Sweet daughter of mine, you are God’s design
You shine bright like a diamond above
You’re blessed with twins, and their new life begins
As they enter this world in God’s love
Chorus
Twins, oh twins, what a holy sign
Two little hearts from the Father divine
Hand in hand, they’re a gift from above
Wrapped in mercy, covered in love
Twins, oh twins, heaven’s song come true
God’s faithfulness is shining over you
Verse 2
Tiny hands and feet, every heartbeat sweet
Every breath is a story of grace
You’ll guide them each day, teach them how to pray
In the shelter of God’s warm embrace
Chorus
Twins, oh twins, what a holy sign
Two little hearts from the Father divine
Hand in hand, they’re a gift from above
Wrapped in mercy, covered in love
Twins, oh twins, heaven’s song come true
God’s faithfulness is shining over you
Bridge
Your children will praise you, as they learn His name
For this new life is raised in the Spirit’s flame
Love, joy, and peace, from the Father above
Patience and kindness, all rooted in love
Goodness and faith, gentle and strong
Self-control leading their hearts in His song
Chorus (final)
Twins, oh twins, what a holy sign
Two little hearts from the Father divine
Hand in hand, they’re a gift from above
Living daily in the Father’s love
Twins, oh twins, lifted up in prayer
God’s perfect love will always meet them there
